import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

> A 30h 50m week, 5h 20m above typical, gave sase 72% and gtd_daily 20%, finished two sase projects, and started two more.

- **Where the time went:** two bullets, `sase` and `gtd_daily`, the only roots at 10% or more. The sase bullet names the GitHub Actions fixes, the sase sites reading, the move of beads to a sidecar repo, and the artifact improvements. The gtd_daily bullet notes that the Fri 31, Sat Aug 1 and Sun 2 rows were each cancelled the next day.
- **Finished:** the two projects completed Aug 1 (`sase_gate`, `actstat`), then seven tasks, then `+more of 48 Done`.
- **Questions:** why gtd_daily took 40–55% of the weekend while those rows were cancelled; what settled the "sawi" rename, created and cancelled Tue 28; and what drove 82 tasks created against 48 done.

**What the draft deliberately doesn't use:**
- **Some brief figures.** The brief's per-task minutes don't add up: the three gtd_daily rows total 8h 30m against a 6h 04m root. I count 51 completed tasks against the brief's Done of 48. The draft therefore gives no per-task minutes and no exact `+N` count.
- **Some brief links.** The brief misses several completions that were moved into `done/` notes, and it prints a dead link for the "sawi" rename. The draft links the `done/` copies instead.

These all match problems earlier phases already recorded. The plan has the coder add a note citing them rather than filing anything new, since I found no new defect in the brief for W31.

The next week's agent (W30) is already marked in progress and may be writing in `~/bob` at the same time. The plan stages and commits only the W31 note, and skips the manual commit if the vault's auto-sync has already committed it.
